Title: Nixie: Efficient, Transparent Temporal Multiplexing for Consumer GPUs
Mechanism: Consumer GPU memory and kernel-launch multiplexing; Linux prototype using CUDA interception.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Generic consumer GPU multiplexing and interactive prioritization are prior art; Windows port alone is insufficient.

Title: Concur: Proactive Agent-Level Admission Control for Efficient Agentic Batch Inference
Mechanism: Regulates long-lived agent admission using KV cache pressure feedback.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Proactive thrashing avoidance and AIMD admission are not new contributions by themselves.

Title: Valve: Production Online-Offline Inference Colocation with Jointly-Bounded Preemption Latency and Rate
Mechanism: Combines bounded compute preemption and rate-limited memory reclamation.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Bounded GPU reclaim or preemption needs comparison with existing runtime systems.

Title: Understanding GPU Resource Interference One Level Deeper
Mechanism: Uses resource-specific microbenchmarks to characterize GPU interference.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Resource perturbation is established; isolate WDDM residency behavior rather than relabel general interference.

Title: Mosaic: GPU Sharing with Latency Guarantees through Kernel-Level Interference Prediction
Mechanism: Predicts kernel interference and uses admission and partitioning for latency goals.
Consequence for proposed novelty: A generic learned predictor plus GPU scheduler is crowded; not a lightweight baseline to reproduce fully on this laptop.

Title: Beyond Microservices: Testing Web-Scale RCA Methods on GPU-Driven LLM Workloads
Mechanism: Evaluates 24 RCA methods under injected faults in LLM deployments.
Consequence for proposed novelty: LLM chaos testing and RCA already exist; proposed work must target residency-specific reduced witnesses on Windows.

Title: CADET: A Systematic Method For Debugging Misconfigurations using Counterfactual Reasoning
Mechanism: Builds causal configuration models and prescribes repairs on Jetson systems.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Counterfactual diagnosis and repair are prior art; experimental identification is required, not a causal label on correlations.

Title: Coz: Finding Code that Counts with Causal Profiling
Mechanism: Uses execution-time interventions to estimate potential optimization effects.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Do not claim invention of causal profiling; adapt justified intervention tests.

Title: Simplifying and Isolating Failure-Inducing Input
Mechanism: Foundational delta debugging of failure-inducing inputs.
Consequence for proposed novelty: A reducer is not itself new; distinguish 1-minimality from a global optimum.

Title: Probabilistic Delta Debugging
Mechanism: Improves selection of reduction attempts using a probabilistic model.
Consequence for proposed novelty: ProbDD is a meaningful algorithmic comparator; its probabilities are not automatic confidence guarantees for noisy GPU outcomes.

Title: Toward a Better Understanding of Probabilistic Delta Debugging
Mechanism: Analyzes why ProbDD skips ineffective reduction queries.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Use ablations to distinguish efficient search heuristics from statistical classification of a noisy failure.

Title: HPAS: An HPC Performance Anomaly Suite for Reproducing Performance Variations
Mechanism: Provides synthetic anomaly generators for performance variation experiments.
Consequence for proposed novelty: A pressure generator or anomaly suite alone is already established.

Title: FlexGen: High-Throughput Generative Inference of Large Language Models with a Single GPU
Mechanism: Optimizes tensor placement across GPU, CPU and disk for throughput-oriented inference.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Intentional offload differs from involuntary spill; do not call all host memory a failure.

Title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
Mechanism: PagedAttention reduces KV fragmentation and redundant duplication.
Consequence for proposed novelty: KV paging and memory sharing are established; this is not a WDDM incident reducer.

Title: PowerInfer: Fast Large Language Model Serving with a Consumer-grade GPU
Mechanism: Exploits activation locality for hybrid CPU/GPU inference.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Changing engine/model sparsity is a separate large project; controlled CPU offload can be useful.

Title: G10: Enabling An Efficient Unified GPU Memory and Storage Architecture with Smart Tensor Migrations
Mechanism: Compiler-assisted tensor migration across memory/storage; simulator-based implementation.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Predictable tensor lifetime and migration optimization are prior art; avoid claiming comparable hardware evidence.

Title: GMLake: Efficient and Transparent GPU Memory Defragmentation for Large-scale DNN Training with Virtual Memory Stitching
Mechanism: Uses GPU virtual memory stitching to reduce allocator fragmentation.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Fragmentation is a separate mechanism from physical residency pressure.

Title: Salus: Fine-Grained GPU Sharing Primitives for Deep Learning Applications
Mechanism: Fast switching and memory sharing for deep learning jobs.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Fine-grained GPU sharing and memory-aware scheduling are established.

Title: AntMan: Dynamic Scaling on GPU Clusters for Deep Learning
Review depth: Abstract and selected paper excerpts from search
Mechanism: Co-designs framework and cluster scheduler for dynamic GPU sharing; Alibaba production deployment.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Provides real company evidence but not evidence of demand for this proposed Windows tool.

Title: Responsive ML inference in multi-tenanted environments using Aqua
Mechanism: Uses other GPUs' memory and fast interconnects for responsive context paging.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Requires a different hardware substrate; not a realistic implementation target on one 6 GB GPU.

Title: DrGPUM: Guiding Memory Optimization for GPU-Accelerated Applications
Mechanism: Attributes memory inefficiencies to data objects and GPU APIs; reports upstreamed fixes.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Explaining GPU memory inefficiency and suggesting fixes are prior art; compare actual tasks.

Title: GPUscout: Locating Data Movement-related Bottlenecks on GPUs
Year or status: Year not verified in this review
Mechanism: Combines SASS analysis, warp stalls and metrics for kernel bottlenecks.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Register spilling, CUDA shared memory and WDDM shared-system-memory spill are distinct.

Title: FIRM: An Intelligent Fine-Grained Resource Management Framework for SLO-Oriented Microservices
Mechanism: Localizes contention and adjusts resources for service latency goals.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Detect-identify-mitigate control loops are established beyond GPUs.

Title: Sage: Leveraging ML to Diagnose Unpredictable Performance in Cloud Microservices
Mechanism: Uses unsupervised learning for root cause diagnosis and corrective action.
Consequence for proposed novelty: A generic learned root-cause dashboard is insufficient differentiation.

Title: Analyzing Query Performance and Attributing Blame for Contentions in a Cluster Computing Framework
Mechanism: ProtoXplore attributes concurrent-query contention using resource acquisition penalties.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Blame assignment needs a defensible metric; largest resource consumer is not necessarily the cause.

Title: Analyzing System Performance with Probabilistic Performance Annotations
Mechanism: Models performance against input/state features to expose regressions.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Regression characterization is established; measure additional value of residency-aware reduction.

Title: GMM: An Efficient GPU Memory Management-based Model Serving System for Multiple DNN Inference Models
Mechanism: Caches multiple models in managed GPU space beyond naive preallocation limits.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Multi-model memory pooling is prior art; do not base novelty on that concept.

Title: An Intelligent Framework for Oversubscription Management in CPU-GPU Unified Memory
Mechanism: Uses access-pattern classification and learned page migration policy.
Consequence for proposed novelty: ML-based thrashing prediction and pre-eviction are already studied.

Title: StreamBox: A Lightweight GPU SandBox for Serverless Inference Workflow
Mechanism: Uses stream-based sandboxes and adaptive memory for serverless workflows.
Consequence for proposed novelty: GPU sandboxing and memory footprint reduction are separate established techniques.

Title: GSI: A GPU Stall Inspector to characterize the sources of memory stalls for tightly coupled GPUs
Review depth: Abstract; fetch also surfaced thesis text
Mechanism: Studies and visualizes sources of GPU memory stalls.
Consequence for proposed novelty: Mechanism attribution predates this project; confirm final bibliography metadata before submission.
